description: Install packages into the renv project library using renv::install(). Supports CRAN packages, GitHub (user/repo), or version-pinned installs.

packages.description: Package names (and optional version specifiers) to install, e.g. ['ggplot2', 'dplyr@1.0.0'].

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

rebuild.description: Whether to rebuild packages from source (default false).

name: renv_install
